nearNote: near variants the stylesheets paint, each in the role its property allows (tokenize.mjs --suggest --near 24): added as palettes, read by a person
readyNote: measured 11/10/2026 on the 1.0.1 release build itself (quickstart/ja-stark/j6 1.0.0 tokenized by release-batch.mjs, stood up from its own zip: tasks/evidence/ds-contracts-r2b-2026-10-11/templates/ja-stark-j6): 12/12, controls 0 differences, no text made less readable than the template's own under the systems tried, 57% or more of the page follows; the page ground, text and green call to action follow through T4's own style template (t4Placeholders: css/tpl/theme.tpl.css), which survives T4 rewriting media/t4/css on install; roles re-pointed to stable elements (the hero's animate.css classes change while it plays), section padding through its #t4-section-N rule, heading sizes !important (utilitiesImportant: its Bootstrap 4 phone sizes are !important); the 'A Design Agency' band is text on a fixed-attachment photo (a full-page screenshot shows the page behind it in every look, the default included); checked by eye on the four systems' screenshots. Re-measured 11/10/2026 with the per-element probe on the same 1.0.1 build (stand.mjs --from-dir, fresh install so T4 generated its theme CSS from the tokenized theme.tpl.css): 12/12, controls 0, no text worse than the template's own, 57%–84% follows, checked by eye (tasks/evidence/ds-remeasure-5-2026-10-11/ja-stark)
selectorsNote: section: the template pads its sections by id (#t4-section-1 … -6 .container, 9.375em): the slot's rule names them the same way (:is(#…) carries an id's weight). buttonPrimary: Stark's call to action is .btn-secondary
utilitiesNote: Stark's compiled Bootstrap 4 sets heading sizes under 992 px !important (h1 2.8125rem!, h2 1.6875rem!): the system's display and heading sizes reach the phone only !important too
t4PlaceholdersNote: the template style's sheet (media/t4/css/<style id>.css) is generated on the site from css/tpl/theme.tpl.css and rewritten whenever it changes — on a fresh install too: it paints the page ground and text (body{background-color:__color_white;color:__body_text_color}) and Bootstrap's colour utilities (.btn-secondary{background-color:__color_secondary!important}) from placeholders. Each placeholder named here reads the slot in the template file itself (tokenize.mjs t4Placeholders), so what T4 writes out does too; __color_secondary is Stark's green call to action, __color_dark only ever as text (a fill keeps its own)
keepScopesNote: the hero, the two navy bands (.t4-section-1, -8: T4 palette 'primary') and the footer keep the template's colours; .t4-section-7 ('Careers at Stark') too: its light grey ground is written by T4's layout settings into the generated style sheet (#t4-section-7{background:#f8f9fa}), which no template file carries, so its text keeps the template's own pair (keepText)
maxVersionNote: 1.0.2 16/10/2026 (#1375): re-cut of 1.0.1 with --move-only: a status colour set as text reads the slot's readable shade (--ds-c-<status>-text); nothing else moved, and unworn the page is the release's own (VERIFICATION.json).
templateVarsNote: none beyond the family's: measured so (11/10/2026, round 2 r2b) — an empty map also keeps pass-joomla.mjs from deriving T4 theme variables (and dropping keepDefaults) on a later run
